name: Unknown Base account module unauthenticated execute drains vault
summary: Account 0xc851e5a0 is an EIP-1167 clone of a router that resolves its logic through a registry to module 0xa2362ea5. That module's ERC725X-style execute(uint256,address,uint256,bytes) performs the call for any caller. Vault 0x36057cb0 lets 0xc851e5a0 withdraw. An attacker's constructor had the account call the vault's withdraw (0xaaa18f86) with itself as recipient and took 300,000 USDC. A second actor repeated the call nine days later and took 100,000 USDC.

loss.notes: Exact USDC debits from vault 0x36057cb08b7c19d8368bcad987484db8184145f6 through the open account execute: 300,000 USDC in source-1 (attacker 0xcccc6400) and 100,000 USDC in source-3 (second actor 0x359e11ab, 2026-05-06). No attacker input is involved. Native USDC on Base is valued at par.

ageReset.description: The registry already resolved module key 0xa487ef877067ccd6a14bb3575c193d40fdd5e6e7654313c354dedbaf3340f89a to 0xa2362ea5 (only event: block 40383887) when the account clone was created with that registry and key in its router slots; both slots and the registry answer are unchanged at block 45258485. execute() is open from the account's creation. The vault's later authorization of this account only set exposure.

limitations: The module, router, registry and vault have no verified source; the missing caller check is established from the struct-log trace of the module frame and from eth_call from an unrelated address, not from source text.

sources.note: Reviewed root cause, first exercise, artifact identity and age. Source-1 (block 45258486, index 51) is a contract creation by EOA 0xcccc640018f8c2b00fa45f456017ad2378eb3447; debug_traceTransaction(callTracer): constructor 0x558cc78118346d6bbc467d8d56dd9b869a7016be CALLs 0xc851e5a046819b022091b50f05ae3bd052e034a4 execute(uint256,address,uint256,bytes) 0x44c028fe(0, 0x36057cb08b7c19d8368bcad987484db8184145f6, 0, aaa18f86(...USDC, 10000 bps, recipient 0x558cc781...)). 0xc851e5a0 runtime is the 45-byte EIP-1167 clone of router 0x039152a960af4500c0d8a516fe78dbc7a9adf5e5 (keccak 0x9977548d075f631ee3d47d32fd470212f4a9521e4c276f8512239d227bb6af45). The router reads account slots 0x76bcfafec7c825a4c7dca64e4482053844ae8ed0629f7a4ab19339f01e5b6f00 (= registry 0xc6f93ff3c785fec1b0ace01e95ebc508c7c57391) and ...6f01 (= key 0xa487ef877067ccd6a14bb3575c193d40fdd5e6e7654313c354dedbaf3340f89a), STATICCALLs registry 0x5c23bdf5(key) -> 0xa2362ea5a670b719aa8b0a155e847d57381e0116 and DELEGATECALLs it. debug_traceTransaction with disableStorage/disableMemory: in the module frame (struct-log steps 2737..3345) the only ops before the CALL to the vault are selector dispatch; there is no CALLER, ORIGIN or SLOAD. eth_call of execute(0, USDC, 0, balanceOf(vault)) on 0xc851 from 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD at block 45258485 succeeds and returns 300000000000. The vault accepts aaa18f86 only from the account: eth_call of the exact inner calldata at block 45258485 returns success from 0xc851e5a0 and reverts with error 0xe8a79f0a(caller) from 0xdEaD and from 0x359e11ab. Identity/age: eth_getCode 0xc851 empty at 40600838, clone hash at 40600839 and 45258485; module 0xa2362ea5 empty at 40382855, keccak 0x8354973cc80491de178f8b9f8fac314f8a51aa2ac9c043f883151cd52a46b60a (14794 bytes) at its deployment block 40382856 (source-7) and at 45258485. Source-2 (block 40600839, index 48, EOA 0x691c975c857182e67ab227e2cb4ffc4daba15654 -> factory 0x4130af430d64c89e174b6fc89c83b864b1859d42) contains CREATE2 of 0xc851 from 0x9d0e2aac65d4d59f55eee0ae301f8064f2859f48. eth_getStorageAt of both router slots is identical at 40600839 and 45258485. eth_call registry 0x5c23bdf5(key) returns 0xa2362ea5 at 40600838, 40600839, 45258485, 45643554 and 45874583. Etherscan logs of the registry through block 45258486 (17 logs) carry this key once: topic0 0x513c59ce42a79dcb2a5797fc1da384bda96df789af0264d5d6ed2d7e4e6e0cb7, topic1 key, topic2 0xa2362ea5, source-4 block 40383887 index 43 log 253, before the account existed, so the account's creation is the module's activation for this context. Earliest exercise: Etherscan txlist of 0xc851 starts at 45259989 (after source-1) and its token and internal-value history before source-1 is empty. Vault token history before source-1 is USDC deposits by 0xbde0c70bdc242577c52dfad53389f82fd149ea5a and outflows to 0x4c07a13deeacefed5a848f39cc6ab2753122a058 through operator selector 0x8c56c940 sent by EOAs 0x9705634378e30744cf3c16b3d56c1cddcc9c55d9, 0x3025b6e53f9a5808aedf69c80411a296342a913c, 0xaac593225e3404cd157b6becb49c5518d243bf20, none via the account. Access-manager 0xdf365eca0d277300f6f42e29e574ee93a82fddb1 logs through block 45258486 (223 logs) grant account role 0x1b7299cdfd7e73da4404de93eefc574e741c8dd991788177b6307b2353ffcf20 only to 0xc851 (in source-2) and sibling 0x466e93a41a29cc4253f8a21d4a819522ac669688 (block 40466255, same clone and router slots), which has no transactions or token transfers. A competitor tx 0xadcdd50a9af32660a41180f6e3c37f29fa901b32ae76b03afe2fbcff1fe25c0f (same block, index 138) moved 0 USDC.

Reviewed loss. Source-1 receipt log 199: USDC Transfer vault 0x36057cb0 -> 0x558cc781 of 300000000000 (6 decimals); log 202 forwards it to 0xcccc6400; the vault balanceOf was 300000000000 after deposit 0xf21f0a7dfa259051fa67b734050410dab54f4387ab9778afc35add8b32c1ae65 (block 45258253) and 0 afterwards. Second campaign: EOA 0x359e11ab0ae393c611f785f8907753954ed1e761 first transacts at block 45259989 with the same execute(0, vault, 0, aaa18f86(...)) call on 0xc851 (0 USDC, vault empty); after deposit 0xd0a555dec155c7dffbbd476d95950005e28f7c2ba117e89d4d12338b505a0187 (block 45643554, 100000000000 USDC from 0xbde0c70b) it repeats the call in source-3 (block 45643555, index 167, timestamp 1778076457), receipt log 402 USDC Transfer vault -> 0x359e11ab of 100000000000; three further calls (45643556, 45643579, 45643599) move 0. 0x359e11ab holds no role and has no earlier relation to the system; it forwards 100000.000099 USDC to 0xadede866f7463ec81b96e88adee4addfa0b7ff46 at block 45683725. Its retry 0x578661383289d57b7840e3f84cf301ee1d7547f63f94a991272a84ce14873ad1 (block 45874584) reverts in the vault, whose registry key 0x7fc90b26a581a6cd1b829c9cfc04e1952ab143c48b635a84efbc03dda2ffd5c0 then resolves to new implementation 0xd4681b08e55f6c4b897e693606ad129d833e891b; later deposits flow only to 0x4c07a13d. Gross loss 400000 USDC at par.
